description: Runlight is open-source web analytics that runs inside your app or as a standalone server. It provides a dashboard, tracking script, short links, reports, and AI-agent-readable analytics for sites you host yourself.
summary: Runlight exposes a self-hosted HTTP API at `/runlight/api`, a built-in MCP server at `/runlight/mcp`, and a standalone server CLI/package (`@runlight/server` / container image).
